description: Expander adding twelve more snapshot slots to TRANSIT, placed immediately to the right of it or of another +T.

params.text: Short-press applies this snapshot to the parameters bound by TRANSIT, or in write mode stores their current values into it; long-press clears it.

notes: the expander carries no settings of its own; the parameters bound, the fade and the sequencing are all set on TRANSIT.
menu: Save, Load, Clear, Copy, Paste, Randomize and save, Shift front, Shift back, Fade, Custom label and Custom color — on a snapshot button's own right-click menu.
